objective: Solve the partial boundary by (1) selecting cutpoints on macro-F1 and (2) deriving the label in code from two independent gates — presence (change_evidence) and completeness (specification_fidelity) — instead of collapsing to min(scores). Partial is where ~64% of held-out errors concentrate.
baseline_preservation: Rubric-Lite v4 min-scalar + frozen artifacts unchanged; two_gate is opt-in via calibration_mode. Cali-Tree v2 unchanged.
hypotheses: H1 (objective): selecting cutpoints on macro_f1 rather than accuracy recovers partial recall from ~0 without collapsing to the majority class.

H2 (two-gate): two independent cutpoints (presence on change_evidence, completeness on specification_fidelity) separate partial where a single min-scalar cutpoint cannot, because ~95% of partial cases share their exact score tuple with a no/yes case under the collapsed scalar.

method.scalar_baseline: min(change_evidence, specification_fidelity, source_preservation) + two ordinal cutpoints (rubric_lite.ordinal_label)
method.two_gate: label = no if change_evidence < presence_cut; yes if specification_fidelity >= completeness_cut; else partial (rubric_lite.two_gate_label)
method.fitting: brute-force two independent cutpoints with a per-class recall floor (0.10), selected on macro_f1; nested task-grouped 5-fold out-of-fold estimate (cross_validate_two_gate, seed 44)
method.target_blind: no editor, task, or instruction features; scores only

dataset.name: ImagenHub/Text_Guided_Image_Editing
dataset.development_status: development/ablation; the out-of-fold CV is the honest metric, not an untouched test

advancement_gate: two_gate must beat both min_scalar rungs on partial F1 and macro F1 (out-of-fold) before advancing to region grounding (docs/experiments, step 3) or any full-1200/second-dataset run. Otherwise record the negative result.
reserved: The untouched EditInspector final 391-case partition is not part of this experiment.
next_if_plateau: Region-grounded completeness signal (open-vocab detection; change inside vs outside the instruction's target region), preregistered separately.
